summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K furnishing a press release solely to disclose logistics for its reconvened Extraordinary General Meeting, to be held September 28, 2026 at Loeb & Loeb LLP, 345 Park Avenue, New York, plus teleconference dial-in details. The registrant states all previously announced meeting information remains unchanged; the underlying definitive proxy statement was filed August 19, 2026. No transaction terms, board recommendation on a business combination, advisor, price, stake, or premium are disclosed. This is a routine meeting-notice update, not a new special-situation event; watch the reconvened vote outcome and any extension or redemption mechanics.
